title: Blind Random Search with Noisy Measurements: Almost Sure Convergence and Convergence Rates
abstract: arXiv:2610.33302v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Blind random search is a simple global optimization method that only requires the value of the loss function, without needing gradient information or an explicit loss model. However, its classical formulation assumes that the loss evaluation is noise-free, which limits its direct application to practical problems with noisy measurements. We extend blind random search by combining a vanishing acceptance threshold with the running average of noisy loss measurements. Under the stated assumptions, we prove that the proposed algorithm converges almost surely to the global minimizer. We further analyze the rate at which the loss at the current estimate approaches the minimum loss. For low-dimensional cases, we obtain an almost sure asymptotic upper bound on the difference between the two, and for high-dimensional cases, we prove that this difference, suitably scaled, has an exact Weibull limiting distribution.

translated_title: 带噪声测量的盲目随机搜索：几乎必然收敛与收敛速率
translated_abstract: 盲目随机搜索是一种简单的全局优化方法，它只需要损失函数的取值，而无需梯度信息或显式的损失模型。然而，其经典形式假设损失评估是无噪声的，这限制了它直接应用于存在噪声测量的实际问题。我们通过将递减的接受阈值与噪声损失测量值的滑动平均相结合，对盲目随机搜索进行了扩展。在所述假设条件下，我们证明了所提出的算法几乎必然收敛到全局最小值点。我们进一步分析了当前估计处的损失逼近最小损失的速度。对于低维情形，我们得到了两者之差的几乎必然渐近上界；对于高维情形，我们证明了该差值经过适当缩放后具有精确的Weibull极限分布。
tldr: 本文将盲目随机搜索扩展至带噪声测量的场景，通过结合递减接受阈值与噪声损失测量值的滑动平均，证明了算法几乎必然收敛到全局最优解，并给出了低维情形下的渐近上界以及高维情形下的Weibull极限分布。
en_tdlr: This paper extends blind random search to noisy measurement settings by combining a vanishing acceptance threshold with running averages of noisy loss measurements, proving almost sure convergence to the global minimizer and deriving an almost sure asymptotic upper bound for low-dimensional cases and an exact Weibull limiting distribution for high-dimensional cases.
